153:t_3:22.en:
$$リディ$$
「I don't give a damn about the family!」

153:t_3:24.en:
$$リディ$$
「This world has no meaning anymore! The world of a hundred years ago, when $$ラプラス$$ was blown up, has been shredded to pieces in this multiverse!」

153:t_3:25.en:
$$リディ$$
「And yet it's the Box, the family, $$クロノ$$! All of us, shackled by that junk!」

153:t_3:26.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Do you... want to destroy the world?」

153:t_3:27.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even if it has no meaning, people are living there...! It can't be helped, can it? All we can do is protect it!」

153:t_3:28.en:
$$リディ$$
「We can't turn everything upside down like those $$ジオン$$ guys!」

153:t_3:29.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's right. The secret of the Box must be protected...! $$ミネバ$$ understands that too!」

153:t_3:30.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「That is exactly why we are asking for your cooperation...」

153:t_3:31.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up! The root of this whole mess is your patriarch!」

153:t_3:32.en:
$$リディ$$
「Your patriarch... $$サイアム・ビスト$$ only got hold of the Box by chance!」

153:t_3:33.en:
$$リディ$$
「In the $$ＵＣＷ$$... no, the $$宇宙世紀$$, he used the $$連邦政府$$'s first president's assassination and the hardline policies after it to rise to power. That went well, but...」

153:t_3:34.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then $$ジオン$$ cried out for Spacenoid independence, the $$一年戦争$$ broke out, and everything changed!」

153:t_3:35.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$連邦政府$$ that had gotten on the rails, and $$サイアム$$ himself who laid them, only then finally realized it!」

153:t_3:36.en:
$$リディ$$
「The meaning of what they had done... The true power that $$ラプラスの箱$$ holds...!」

153:t_3:37.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You know it... what $$ラプラスの箱$$ really is...」

153:t_3:38.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please tell me. What is this Box that torments you so badly? Everyone here has the right to know.」

153:t_3:39.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why would a relic of one world have meaning in this multiverse?」

153:t_3:40.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Multiverse... and parallel worlds... Those are just names. Every world is rotting in the same way...」

153:t_3:42.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ミネバ$$, come with me!」

153:t_3:44.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$ユニコーン$$ is dangerous...! No, it's not only that machine that's dangerous!」

153:t_3:45.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$s, $$イノベイター$$s... No, $$コーディネイター$$s are the same too!」

153:t_3:46.en:
$$リディ$$
「The existence of those people turns $$ラプラスの箱$$... the prayer offered up in one world a hundred years ago... into a curse!」

153:t_3:48.en:
$$リディ$$
「I don't have the power to change the world. Even if the order is imperfect, if there's no way to change it, I'll protect it.」

153:t_3:49.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are coming from space too. Unless we stabilize the world even a little right now, this planet, and you...」

153:t_3:52.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「It's the $$サイデリアル$$! They're attacking $$オーブ$$!」

153:t_3:53.en:
$$マーサ$$
(Too soon... No, it's because our own departure was delayed...)

153:t_3:54.en:
$$マーサ$$
(All that's certain is that they give no thought at all to us, who pledged our cooperation...)

153:t_3:56.en:
$$リディ$$
「Wait for me, $$ミネバ$$! I'm coming over there right now!」

153:t_3:57.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...$$リディ$$... You and I walk different paths.」

153:t_3:58.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is this the time to say that!? If you fall from there, you'll die!」

153:t_3:59.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I am a woman of the $$ザビ家$$. I will see the truth of $$ラプラスの箱$$ with my own eyes.」

153:t_3:60.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I believed that even a warped order was better than war, but if it only suffocates people...」

153:t_3:62.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In this confused world, doing such a thing may be meaningless.」

153:t_3:63.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「By seeking the truth I may cause even more confusion, and commit a grave sin like my father and grandfather. But I...」

153:t_3:64.en:
$$リディ$$
「You intend to fight the world alone!?」

153:t_3:66.en:
$$リディ$$
「Nobody believes the world will change! Everyone couldn't care less about a world a hundred years from now, when they won't even be here!」

153:t_3:67.en:
$$リディ$$
「Besides that, what those people are after is how to survive!」

153:t_3:68.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But without a future, people despair. People learned that in the $$時獄戦役$$.」

153:t_3:69.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And I am not alone. The light in people's hearts has turned that into conviction.」

153:t_3:71.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Goodbye. I will not forget you...」

154:t_000:0.en:
$$キサカ$$
「The unit that $$アナハイム$$ arranged is coming!」

154:t_000:1.en:
$$カガリ$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ that defected to the $$サイデリアル$$...!」

154:t_000:2.en:
$$キサカ$$
「Also, the $$アークエンジェル$$ is holding off the enemy advance from the north of the island!」

154:t_000:3.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Send out the Onogoro Island defense force!」

154:t_001:0.en:
$$キサカ$$
「All units! The enemy's target is this residence! Don't let them get anywhere near it!」

154:t_002:0.en:
$$リディ$$
(That old man... Is this the day he meant when he told me to leave $$オーブ$$ after moving $$ミネバ$$...)

154:t_002:1.en:
$$リディ$$
(Damn it...! With the world in a state like this, how far does the rot go...!)

154:t_002:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Let's do it, $$キラ$$! Those guys have deviated from the Federation's regular army! In other words, they're Earth's enemy!」

154:t_002:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you're going to insist on not aiming for the cockpits, do as you like. I'll do as I please.」

154:t_003:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「So those guys... were in my old man's pocket too...」

154:t_004:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Even so, let's do it, Ensign $$リディ$$. To protect what's precious to us.」

154:t_004:2.en:
$$リディ$$
(It's not the $$マーセナス家$$... It's...)

154:t_004:6.en:
$$マーサ$$
「There's no need to worry. Our ride will be here soon.」

154:t_004:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$. What is the meaning of this?」

154:t_004:9.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「$$マリーダ$$...? I am Proto $$プルトゥエルブ$$.」
